anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: Both ἀρχή and πρῶτος are used, not one word only.

choices.why: Technical: Scripture knows how to distinguish the two words.

pass_a_gloss: For he could have said: This month is for you beginning of months and of the year, or: This month is first of the year for you; but as of some distinction being, he says the month is both beginning and first.
pass_b_english: For he could have said: "This month is for you the beginning of months and of the year," (Exodus 12:2) or: "This month is first of the year for you." But as if there were some distinction, he says that the month is both a beginning and first.
source_text: [Ἐδ]ύνατ[ο γὰρ εἰ]ρ[η]κέναι· "Ὁ [μ]ὴν οὗ[τος] ὑμῖν ἀρχὴ μηνῶν κ[αὶ το]ῦ ἐνιαυτοῦ ἐστι[ν]", ἤ· "Ὁ μὴν [οὗτος] πρῶτος τοῦ ἐνιαυτοῦ ἐστιν ὑμῖν", ἀλλ’ ὡς διαστολῆς τινος οὔσης λέγει καὶ ἀρχὴν τὸν μῆνα καὶ πρῶτον αὐτὸν εἶναι.
